purpose: Register of departures from the frozen V5 plan (docs/V5_RUNSHEET.md, hash in results/v5/v5_plan_freeze.json). Every entry is reported in the manuscript's protocol-deviation statement (TRIPOD+AI / CONSORT-AI practice; IEEE publication ethics: no selective reporting). An entry is valid only if declared BEFORE the data it concerns are read.

deviations.declared_before: any fold 1-4 V5 prediction exists (Q7 not started; results/v5/preds has no f1-f4 files)
deviations.what: Add m4 (in22k, 224 px) folds 1-4 x s42 as a SECONDARY confirmation arm (queue_Q7b.txt, tag v5conf).
deviations.why: Q6 stacking check found the locked composite sub-additive on fold 0 (composite vs m4: -0.0119 all-age pAUC, -0.0191 histo; +0.0114 <40 pAUC; results/v5/screens/gate_composite_in22k_vs_m4.json). The plan's risk table (V5_PLAN_AMENDMENT_02 'gains don't add up') put Q6 there to act on this, but specified no action. Fold 0 is the selection fold and m4 passed its own gate by +0.004 vs a 0.0035 bar, so its fold-0 lead is selection-inflated; only held-out folds can test the young-data trade-off.
deviations.unchanged: Lock (results/v5/composite_lock.json, sha256 a34bd78c4e3098d906bf8cabbc49d0e863f33f20d7fc905f5a34b0081f456059), primary contrast (composite vs banked in1k R0 control, folds 1-4, Gates A/B/D), comparator, resolution, seeds, gate thresholds.
secondary_contrasts: m4 vs in1k control (Gates A/B/D computed, reported as secondary)
composite vs m4 (estimate + lesion-grouped hierarchical interval; no gate)
binding_constraints: No secondary result can change the lock, the primary verdict, or the V5 system definition after it is read.
All three contrasts are reported whatever their direction.
Multiplicity: the primary is the sole member of its family; the two secondaries form one family, Holm-adjusted, labelled secondary.

deviations.kind: gap fix, not a design change
deviations.what: Score the banked in1k control checkpoints R0_kfold_f{1..4}_s42_last.pt with research.v5.infer_last (last epoch, same self-check) before Q7.
deviations.why: The runsheet's Q1 scored only fold-0 control runs; the confirmation comparator for folds 1-4 had run JSONs but no per-image last-epoch predictions (results/v4/kfold/predictions holds best-epoch fold CSVs only). Reading the comparator at its best epoch would bias every paired delta (infer_last docstring: S72 fold 0 best 0.6508 vs last 0.6394).

deviations.declared_before: any fold-0 OOF assembly, Dirichlet refit, S56 refit or S84 read
deviations.what: Fold 0 of the V5 15-model OOF reuses the Q6 runs composite_f0_s{42,43,44}_in22k_v5stack instead of retraining fold 0 under composite_lock.json.
deviations.why: Q6 trained exactly the locked module set {twostep, m4, youngdata} with the same extra_train file, trunk, resolution, recipe and seeds; only the spec file status ('candidate' vs 'locked') and --no-save-best differ. _last is the primary checkpoint, so --save-best is immaterial. Saves ~3.7 GPU-h.
deviations.unchanged: Modules, data, recipe, seeds, last-epoch primary; fold 0 stays the flagged selection fold (it was used to choose the composite).
binding_constraints: Fold 0 rows are reported as the selection fold wherever the 15-model OOF is used.

deviations.what: S84 MILK10k single read and the S56-on-V5 refit are deferred to the post-Review-2 V5 addendum (runsheet 8.2 'if time allows' / 'after Review 2').
deviations.why: Owner decision after the E14 read; time goes to the fairness audit and Review-2 deliverables. MILK10k stays unread (no receipt), so V6 allocation is unchanged.
deviations.unchanged: S84 spec (runsheet 9), its receipt guard and single-read rule.

deviations.what: Q11 (IN-22k trunk-only control, no modules, 224 px, tag v5conf) is queued for seeds 42, 43 and 44 on folds 1-4 (12 runs, results/v5/queue_Q11.txt) instead of seed 42 only (4 runs). Declared before any seed-43 run starts; the seed-42 runs began 2026-10-05 02:48.
deviations.why: The three-seed confirmation (results/v5/confirm_s42_s43_s44.json) is paired seed by seed; a one-seed trunk contrast could not be set against it. The 224 px arm also doubles as V6 A13.1.
deviations.read_rule: Descriptive, no gate. Two paired contrasts through research/v5/confirm_read.py machinery (same hierarchical seed x lesion bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, RNG seed 20261004): locked composite minus Q11 control (module + young-data effect on the same trunk) and Q11 control minus in1k control (trunk effect). Endpoints: all-age and under-40 escalation pAUC@0.20, Macro-F1. Read once, after all 12 runs finish; no Q11 prediction file is opened before then.
deviations.unchanged: Lock (results/v5/composite_lock.json), the confirmation read, Gates A-D, the recipe, 30 epochs, --num-workers 2, no test, reserved or external read.

deviations.declared_before: any S84 or MILK10k read (no results/v5/s84_receipt.json), any read of a value in results/v5/s75_milk10k_eligibility.json by this declaration, any V1 prediction on the power rows, and any V1-vs-V5 discordance computation
deviations.kind: pre-read specification of the S84 power method (runsheet 9 'Power', A01 A9) and of document precedence
deviations.what: (a) S84 power uses V1-vs-V5 discordance on the non-HAM rows of OOF folds 1-4 only: archive in {bcn20000, mskcc}, excluding any row sharing group_id, dup_cluster or effective_lesion_id with a HAM row (6,672 rows, 2,838 lesions, 37 under-40 escalating lesions; one image excluded, ISIC_0010852, a near-duplicate of HAM training image ISIC_0032195). Power is the unconditional power of the one-sided exact McNemar test (alpha 0.05) on N = under40_escalating_lesions from the S75 file, with lesion-weighted discordance at matched referral and a 2,000-resample lesion-grouped bootstrap band (RNG seed 20261004). (b) Runsheet 9 governs S84 wholly; the one-sample exact binomial power, N >= 40 floor, Macro-F1 >= 0.75 boundary, tau80 threshold and fixed-sequence gate in results/v5/v5_external_analysis_spec.md are not used for any S84 decision.
deviations.why: (a) The 6,981 HAM rows of the OOF are the HAM train split on which all six frozen V1 CNNs were trained and V1's Dirichlet and S56 layers were fit, so V1 would be scored in-sample against an out-of-fold V5, understating V5-favouring discordance and power by an amount that cannot be estimated. On BCN20000/MSKCC rows V1 is external and V5 out-of-fold from a pool containing those archives, the same position both systems hold on MILK10k (partly same-institution). Cost: 37 instead of 64 under-40 escalating lesions, carried into the reported power band. (b) The spec powers a different test (one-sample binomial) in a different hierarchy from the hashed runsheet's primary (paired exact McNemar at matched referral); runsheet 9 is the frozen plan (results/v5/v5_plan_freeze.json).
deviations.unchanged: S84 systems, primary endpoint and test (paired under-40 escalation sensitivity at matched referral, exact McNemar, one-sided alpha 0.05), key secondary (S70 contract, Clopper-Pearson), global Macro-F1 non-inferiority margin 0.02, descriptives, single-read receipt rule, MILK10k allocation (A01 B8).
binding_constraints: Power is reported whatever it is; below 0.80 the primary result is labelled underpowered.
Power never changes whether S84 runs, its alpha, its row definitions or its analysis.
Stated residual bias: the V5 Dirichlet and S56 refits are fit on the whole V5 OOF including these rows, so the power estimate is slightly optimistic.

deviations.declared_before: any S84 stage (no results/v5/s84/ directory, no results/v5/s84_receipt.json), any V5 or V1 prediction on a MILK10k image, and the power computation (no results/v5/s84/power.json)
deviations.kind: pre-read correction of the S84 eligibility rule (leakage)
deviations.what: S84 excludes from every analysis any MILK10k dermoscopic lesion whose ISIC Archive lesion_id appears in ISIC 2019 Training (collection 65), ISIC 2019 Test (collection 72) or the V5 young extras. The list is frozen in results/v5/s84_lesion_links.json (985 lesions: 859 Training, 126 Test, 2 extras, overlapping), built label-free by research/v5/s84_lesion_links.py from a live ISIC API pull (snapshot results/v5/isic2019_archive_lesion_ids.csv), and pinned in the S84 receipt. The S75 cohort (5,220) is kept whole in cohort.csv with a lesion_linked flag so that S75's label-mapping check still runs on all of it at the one label read; decisions, referral matching and every statistic use the unlinked lesions only.
deviations.why: S75's rule matches images (ISIC id, or dHash AND pHash within 3), and 0 MILK10k images share an ISIC id with ISIC 2019, but MILK10k re-photographs lesions already in ISIC 2019: 616 MILK10k lesions are the same lesions as V5 development training rows (verified 2026-11-02 against ml/data/manifest_v4.csv). V5 trained on those lesions and V1 on the HAM ones, so including them would score both systems partly in-sample on an external cohort.
deviations.information_seen_before_declaring: The declarer had read results/v5/s75_milk10k_eligibility.json (label counts only; no predictions exist) and a literature-agent note that about 21 of MILK10k's young escalating lesions are HAM-linked. The rule is all-or-nothing by lesion identity, with no threshold or choice that those counts could tune.
deviations.unchanged: S84 systems, primary endpoint and test, key secondary, global Macro-F1 non-inferiority, descriptives, single-read receipt rule, D5 power method. Power is still computed at S75's pre-exclusion N (71 under-40 escalating lesions), so it is an upper bound; the report states the analysed N.
binding_constraints: The lesion-linked lesions are never analysed, whatever their predictions.
Lesion identity rests on the lesion_id links contributors recorded in the ISIC Archive; unrecorded links cannot be excluded (stated limitation).
